column7:
We upgraded our Portal at the end of last year. We promote it through media and have a class of students analyze and give suggestions how to improve the portal.

Last year, we improved the Portal with a new version of CKAN, improved receiving comments from users, implemented a new version of Moodle, added a new CMS and renewed the overall design.

column2: 2.4 Portal sustainability

Does the national portal have a strategy to ensure its sustainability?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please (1) provide the URL to this document and (2) describe the main measures to keep the portal running in the long-term and continue to serve its audience
column7:
The national portal is sustainable. The company that also upgraded the portal through the Open Data project is in charge of maintaining the portal and adding new functionalities. The number of publishers and published data sets is constantly increasing. High-value data sets can also be reached by filtering. The implementation of the project "Adaptation of information systems of public sector bodies to the Open Data Portal" technologically and visually improved the Open Data Portal (data.gov.hr). 
As necessary, new projects will be launched to improve the open data portal.
